name: sgnl-focus
description: Run the SGNL method in a conversation: confirm 1 to 3 objectives inferred from what your assistant already knows, open an 18-hour cycle from everything on your plate, get 3 to 5 sgnls whose bits are your decisions, with drafts offered in chat, report done or blocked, and close with a recap and ratio. Drafts only: it never sends or changes anything in another system. Skills only.

interface.longDescription: A fixed planning cycle you run in chat. On first use it infers 1 to 3 objectives from what your assistant already knows and shows one line of evidence for each; you confirm or dismiss with one reply. To open an 18-hour cycle, you paste everything on your plate, unsorted. Each item is scored against your objectives: only items that move an objective's end state inside its horizon become sgnls, capped at 3 to 5. A playbook for the type of work (fundraising, email funnel, ship and test, sales, hiring, support, updates, content) makes each bit a decision only you can make, and the assistant offers to draft the rest in chat. It drafts; you send. It never sends, deletes, merges, publishes, pays, or marks anything done in another system. Everything else is listed once as noise. The sgnls stay fixed for the cycle, and you report only done or blocked. At close you give hours, and you get a ratio of sgnl hours to awake hours against a target of 80 percent and a floor of 50. Every reply ends with a short state block you can paste into a new chat to resume. The plugin keeps no record outside your chat and makes no network calls.
capabilities: Pick 3 to 5 sgnls for an 18-hour cycle
defaultPrompt: Start my SGNL. Infer my objectives from what you know about my work and show me the evidence.
Open an SGNL cycle. It is Thu 2026-10-01 09:00. My plate: fix export bug, email 5 trial users, tidy desk.
Explain the SGNL method in five lines, then propose my objectives.
